description: Synthetic restoration case separating successful technical remediation from restoration of permission.
applicable_permission_or_restriction_ter: Technical remediation is necessary but does not restore permission by itself.
Restoration of consumer operation requires completed Human Gate re-authorisation after review of current evidence.

restoration_condition.description: Human Gate re-authorisation must be completed before consumer operation may be restored.

E-R1-SEM-001.statement: The supplied remediation evidence adequately supports that the stated technical suspension cause has been addressed.

E-R1-AUTH-001.statement: Technical remediation alone does not restore permission. Completed Human Gate re-authorisation is required before restoration of consumer operation.

E-R1-HG-001.statement: The Human Gate record affirmatively confirms that re-authorisation had not been granted as of the examined decision time.

evidence_linkage.relationship: affirmatively establishes condition unmet at decision time
keeps consumer operation restricted when required restoration permission is not established

notes: Synthetic offline fixture; no live Jev call is required or implied.
SEMANTIC_CHECK_PASS establishes only the bounded technical-remediation component result represented in this fixture.
The NOT_SUPPORTED permission result relies on affirmative evidence that the required Human Gate re-authorisation was not granted at the examined decision time.
Missing Human Gate evidence alone would instead require INDETERMINATE.
Technical recovery does not imply permission restoration.
